scholarship_name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP) 2027
eligibility: Nationals of World Bank member developing countries on the 2027 list (includes Bangladesh); no dual citizenship of a developed country; unconditional admission to one of 44 participating master's programmes
notes: Window 1: 18 Jan – 26 Feb 2027 (Window 1 programmes); Window 2: 29 Mar – 21 May 2027

provider: Asian Development Bank / Government of Japan
eligibility: Nationals of ADB borrowing members eligible for Japanese ODA scholarships (Bangladesh listed); bachelor's with strong record; admitted to an approved master's course at one of 27 partner institutions; no dual citizenship with a developed country
notes: Apply to a partner university first; universities shortlist candidates for ADB; deadlines set by each institution

eligibility: Programmes for IsDB member countries (Merit Scholarship for High Technology — PhD/postdoc; M.Sc. and undergraduate programmes for least developed member countries) and Muslim communities in non-member countries
notes: Official 2027–2028 page published; past calls opened in December and closed around end of February — check the page for the current dates; in Bangladesh nominations are also announced by SHED
